banking-economy.title: Relief for Chanda Kochhar as HC quashes ICICI Bank's nod to prosecute ex-CEO in 'loan fraud' case
banking-economy.summary: The Bombay High Court quashed the ICICI Bank's sanction for prosecuting Chanda Kochhar in an alleged fraud case. The court found that the authority granting the sanction did not apply proper judgment to the circumstances. Chanda Kochhar was arrested in December 2022 and received interim bail in January 2023. The case involved a loan of Rs 3,250 crore given to Videocon Group during her tenure.

sectors.title: Chinese national Li Ming charged in fraud case in Singapore linked to Megaspeed and Alice Huang: Report
sectors.summary: Li Ming, a Chinese national, is facing fraud charges in Singapore regarding alleged transshipment of Nvidia chips. He was involved with Megaspeed, a company linked to Alice Huang, the former romantic partner of Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang. Li is accused of misleading an American supplier by misrepresenting the intended destination of purchased servers. Following an investigation, Megaspeed was placed on a no sell list by Nvidia.
